title: SynechismCore: Continuous-Time Latent Dynamics for Long-Horizon Chaotic Forecasting under Irregular Sampling
description: Code, results and technical report (paper/Harris_2026_Continuous-Time_Latent_Dynamics_Irregular_Sampling.pdf) for a study of whether continuous-time latent dynamics improve long-horizon forecasting of chaotic systems under irregular sampling. SynechismV23, a latent neural ODE, is compared with Transformer, LSTM and Mamba forecasters on the Lorenz-63 system under four sampling regimes, with all models trained to convergence over 5 seeds. SynechismV23 attains the longest valid prediction time in every regime.
